svg.font-family: 'DM Sans', Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: React and Next.js Developer roadmap
svg.desc: 01 HTML, CSS and Accessibility: Semantic HTML, CSS layout, Responsive design, Accessibility basics, Styling approaches; 02 JavaScript and TypeScript: Modern JavaScript, Asynchronous JavaScript, TypeScript essentials, Packages and build tools, Linting and formatting; 03 Framework Fundamentals: Components and JSX, Props and children, State, Rendering lists and conditions, Handling events, React Developer Tools; 04 State and Data Flow: Lifting state up, Reducers and context, Effects and when to avoid them, Refs, Custom hooks, Shared state libraries; 05 Routing: Client-side routing, URL parameters and query strings, Layouts and nested routes, Guarding routes, Code splitting; 06 Forms and Validation: Controlled inputs, React Hook Form, Schema validation with Zod, Accessible error messages, Form actions in React 19; 07 Working with APIs: Fetching data and loading states, Server state with TanStack Query, Handling API errors, Rendering user content safely, Tokens in the browser, CORS; 08 Rendering and the Meta-Framework: App Router, Server and Client Components, Data fetching and caching, Server Actions, Proxy and authentication, Rendering strategies; 09 Testing: Component tests, Mocking APIs with MSW, End-to-end tests with Playwright, Accessibility testing; 10 Performance and Production: Core Web Vitals, Bundle size and code splitting, Images and fonts, Security headers, Error monitoring and logging, Deployment
svg.text: Effects and when to avoid them
Every topic has a guide in the stage pages next to this image.
